name: Court no Naka no Tenshi-tachi 2 ~Softball Hen~
original_name: コートの中の天使達2～ソフトボール編～
source:
The main character is a gentle-minded lecturer who is ordered to supervise the "Women's Softball Club" immediately after his arrival. He has to deal with the resignation of almost all members after a spring training camp incident with the last coach. Is restoring the club even possible?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名性格温和的讲师，刚刚到任便被命令负责指导‘女子垒球部’。前任教练在春季集训中引发事故后，几乎所有部员都退出了。他还有可能重建这个社团吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
